objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Log in to DVWA, use the Command Injection module to run a command on the web server, and read /ctf/flag.
hints: One module pings a host you name. How does the server run that ping?
At the low security level the input goes to a shell unfiltered: think about shell command separators as a vulnerability class.

steps.title: Pick the module
steps.prompt: Which DVWA module hands your input to an operating system command?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which request parameter of that module reaches the command? (its name)

steps.title: Choose the level
steps.prompt: At which DVWA security level is that input passed on without any filtering?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets a second command run after the intended one?
